business_problem: Riyadh Air wanted to avoid the legacy-system bottlenecks that slow most airlines and instead build a cloud-native operating model that could coordinate guest journeys, operations and service decisions in real time from day one.
solution_summary: Riyadh Air partnered with IBM to build an AI-native airline architecture rather than layering AI onto legacy systems. IBM Consulting coordinated 59 workstreams across more than 60 partners and used IBM watsonx Orchestrate as the control plane for specialized AI agents spanning commercial, operational and service domains. IBM also implemented a hybrid cloud integration platform on Microsoft Azure Red Hat OpenShift powered by IBM Cloud Pak for Integration, giving the airline a modular fabric for moving contextual data across more than 75 systems and over 1,800 integrations. On top of that foundation, AI agents support contact-center resolution, crew coordination and digital concierge experiences, while the airline’s website, mobile app and service tools run on an AI-native customer layer that adapts offers and decisions in real time.
